description: [roadmap S3.4, settled by S3.5] The palette a sheet cell is drawn with: drawQueuedSprite passes the queue entry's palette object g_images[flags] (golfers g_images[0], composed by composeGolferSprite) as Sprite_draw's mask; Sprite_draw (c3da.cpp, handle slot +0x78) hands mask->m_4 to Sprite::blt16a (jgld 0x10019830), which stores it in the Sprite's +0x10 word when it is non-zero and never restores it (re/match/jgld_sprite.cpp blt16a: `saved` unused); the plane blit draw16_100298b0 reads that word. A cell's word starts at 0 (S3.4's recordings). The port (gfx_scene.cpp sprite_palette) keeps the word per sprite key; flic::sheet_to_gfx's slot palettes are not used for cells. Frames: sandbox_basic's view 107,000 px -> 51 one-level px.
